messages.subject: Bug in loadAlleleCounts()
messages.body_plain:
Hi

There is a bug in loadAlleleCounts in version 1.10.0 of TitanCNA.

Error message when calling loadAlleleCounts():
Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, , 1, value = ...  : replacement has X rows, data has Y

Cause: line 133 in utils.R
data[, 1] <- setGenomeStyle(data[, 1], genomeStyle)

Description:
The function setGenomeStyle() filters out rows that do not match genomeStyle. Since in the above code line only the first column is replaced, this results in a mismatch of the number of rows in data and the number of elements returned by setGenomeStyle() and hence in an error message.

Workaround:
Add function setGenomeStyle2 (see below) to utils.R, which is similar to setGenomeStyle, but returns the entire data matrix instead of just a single column.
Then change line 133 in utils.R to data <- setGenomeStyle2(data, data[, 1], genomeStyle) and reinstall the (modified) TitanCNA package.

setGenomeStyle2 <- function(data, x, genomeStyle = "NCBI", species = "Homo_sapiens") {
  if (!genomeStyle %in% seqlevelsStyle(as.character(x))) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(mapSeqlevels(as.character(x), genomeStyle, drop = FALSE)[1,])
  }
  autoSexMChr <- extractSeqlevelsByGroup(species = species, style = genomeStyle, group = "all")
  data <- data[x %in% autoSexMChr, ]
  return(data)
}

Hope this helps.
Jonas
